steps.text: After signing in you land on your home page. It lists the communities you belong to, along with your role in each one.
steps.title: Your communities

steps.text: Click the button on the Test Community card to open it. That community becomes your active one: the management menu and every page that follows relate to it.
steps.title: Enter the community

steps.text: A new "Management" menu appears in the sidebar, granting access to the community's keys, meters and sharing operations.
steps.title: Management menu unlocked
